summary.text: Joanne Shofner is a Republican state representative from Texas who has represented District 11 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She works as a consultant and has been affiliated with Nacogdoches County Republican Women.

paragraphs.text: Joanne Shofner was born in Houston, Texas.
Her career experience includes working as a consultant and manager, and she has been affiliated with Nacogdoches County Republican Women.
Shofner assumed office in the Texas House on January 14, 2025, succeeding Travis Clardy, a Republican.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Shofner described herself as a small business leader, a ministry leader and the president of Nacogdoches County Republican Women.
She listed her campaign's key messages as securing the Texas border, education savings accounts and election integrity, including voter ID and paper ballots.
